csv_scope_of_work: The Vineland Housing Authority ( VHA or the Authority ) is soliciting proposals from qualified, licensed Architectural and Engineering (A/E) firms to provide professional services on an as-needed, indefinite-quantity, task order basis. The selected A/E firm(s) shall provide professional architectural and multidisciplinary engineering services, including but not limited to architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and related consulting services, for residential and commercial development, modernization, rehabilitation, maintenance, and capital improvement projects as assigned by the Authority. Services may include, but are not limited to: Programming, planning, and feasibility studies, and physical needs assessments / capital needs assessments (PNA/CNA) and facility condition evaluations Conceptual design and schematic design Design development and construction documentation Cost estimating and budget development Permitting assistance and regulatory coordination Preparation of bid scope and assistance during the bidding process Evaluation of bids and recommendations for award Construction administration and project oversight Review of shop drawings, submittals, RFIs, and related contractor documentation Site inspections, field reports, and project closeout services Mechanical, electrical, and building systems evaluation and design, including HVAC, plumbing, elevator-related, and other infrastructure improvements
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies
